key_insight: AI can unify instability studies in 3D all-inorganic perovskites by linking diagnosis, mechanism discovery, reliability prediction, and engineering design across coupled degradation pathways.
engineering_relevance: The review positions AI as a practical tool to guide more stable CsPbX3 materials and devices under thermal, chemical, optical, and electrical stress.
evidence_signal: The review highlights that current studies rely on multimodal, protocol-dependent, sparse data and require better uncertainty quantification and benchmark design.
watch_item: A major implementation concern is limited data quality and transferability across domains, which can weaken model reliability if not addressed with standardized benchmarks.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
